sample_description: 50 nm TiO2 film by thermal ALD from TDMAT/H2O with an in situ air dose in every cycle (TDMAT/H2O/air: 1.0 s TDMAT / 5 s N2 / 0.4 s H2O / 15 s N2 / 35 s air / 35 s N2) on Si with native oxide; crystalline anatase as deposited; Renishaw inVia Qontor
conditions: ALD deposition T=180 °C; as-deposited; laser 10% power, 2 s acquisition
notes: paper: Eg; one set of positions stated for both the 180 and 200 °C 50 nm films; the A1g band (quoted as 514 cm-1) is hidden by the Si line and not observed, so not extracted; thinner (25 nm) and 220 °C films show weaker anatase bands without numbers
